evidence: X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis using Cu Kα radiation was used to determine the crystal structures of the SrTiO3 thin films. Cross-sectional transmission electron microscopy (TEM) was used to study the formation of the SRO interlayer, and the corresponding elemental information was determined using the energy dispersive x-ray spectrometry (EDS) TEM technique. To measure the dielectric constant, sputtered platinum was used as a top electrode and the dielectric constant was measured using a C-V analyzer (Keithley 590) at a frequency of 1 MHz.
